_about: NS22 domain-aware router. Routes Int goals to the NS22 fallback_omega ablation checkpoint (which outperformed the iff_omega_pair candidates 57/158 vs 39/158 vs 35/158 on the CX1+CX2 Int test surface). Finset stays on NS21 20x, Nat on NS15, Set/default on NS12. The choice of omega_5x for Int is contrary to the initial NS22-A plan; per the Stage 4 matrix, the short `omega` tactic transferred broadly to the iff_omega pool (9/10 solved via omega) while the long iff-pair tactic failed to memorize at all.
